quotations: North American companies ordered 10,989 robots valued at $723.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, according to the latest data from the Association for Advancing Automation, or A3. Orders increased 24.8% in units and 26.1% in value compared with the third quarter of 2025, making it the strongest quarter of the year so far, it said.
Orders from automotive component suppliers climbed 90.4%, continuing the strong demand from that segment seen earlier in the year.
